metadata.case_name: CHAN CHUNG KUEN v. MTR CORPORATION LTD

injuries.description: fracture of distal third of his left tibia
source: Chan was sent to the Alice Ho Miu Ling Nethersole Hospital where X-ray showed fracture of distal third of his left tibia and left fibula neck (leg).
They agreed on the diagnosis of left tibia shaft spiral fracture and left proximal fibular fracture.
Chan was sent to the Alice Ho Miu Ling Nethersole Hospital where X-ray showed fracture of distal third of his left tibia and left fibula neck (leg).
They agreed on the diagnosis of left tibia shaft spiral fracture and left proximal fibular fracture.

manifestations.description: intermittent pain in the left lower leg
continuous numbness in the left lower leg
mild muscle wasting of the left thigh and mild to moderate wasting of the left calf
limping and reduced walking and standing tolerance
some decrease in dexterity of the left lower leg

treatments_received.treatment: left long leg plaster cast slab for temporary immobilisation
source: Chan was given a left long leg plaster cast slab for temporary immobilisation.

treatments_received.treatment: close reduction and internal fixation of the left tibia
source: Close reduction and internal fixation of the left tibia was performed 5 days later.
treatments_received.vmis_procedure: Closed reduction for fracture of arm / leg / patella / pelvis with internal fixation

treatments_received.treatment: transfer to Tai Po Hospital for rehabilitation and physiotherapy
source: He was transferred to Tai Po Hospital for rehabilitation and physiotherapy.
He was transferred to Tai Po Hospital for rehabilitation and physiotherapy.
He was reported to be unwilling to undergo such therapy; and he opted for self-mobilisation exercise instead.
Dr Ko opined that removal of the metal implants would be advisable in the case of a relatively young active individual for the avoidance of future complications.
Dr Ho did not believe that removing the implants would significantly reduce Chans left leg pain. He agreed with Dr Ko that the numbness would persist even when the implant was removed.
treatments_future.vmis_procedure: Removal of screw, pin and plate, and other metal for old fracture except fracture femur

losses.description: Reduced walking and standing tolerance; limping and stiffness in left ankle resulting from left leg injuries
Reduced work efficiency and effectiveness; reduced lifting and carrying capacity due to residual weakness in left lower limb
